title: Autonomic Nervous System (Pharmacology, Receptors, and Physiology)

sentences.text: In this video, I'm going to be talking about the autonomic nervous system with a special emphasis on autonomic nervous system pharmarmacology.
sentences.zh: 在本视频中，我将讨论自主神经系统，特别强调自主神经系统的药理学。

sentences.text: That said, although the focus of this video is going to be on all of the different drugs that you need to know regarding the autonomic nervous system, I'm still going to touch on things like the different types of
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，尽管本视频的重点是您需要了解的所有关于自主神经系统的不同药物，但我仍会涉及诸如不同类型的受体和自主神经系统的一般生理学等内容，以帮助您建立真正掌握药理学所需的背景信息。

sentences.text: receptors and just general physiology in the autonomic nervous system to help you establish the background information that's needed to really master the pharmarmacology.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我们进入今天的视频。

sentences.text: Now, let's get into today's video.
sentences.zh: 在开始讨论细节之前，我想先概述一下自主神经系统。

sentences.text: And I want to sort of paint an overview of the autonomic nervous system before we start talking about nitty-gritty details.
sentences.zh: 自主神经系统分为两个部分。

sentences.text: The autonomic nervous system is broken down into two components.
sentences.zh: 您有交感神经系统和副交感神经系统。

sentences.text: You've got the sympathetic nervous system and the parasympathetic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 通常，您可能听说过它们被称为“战斗或逃跑”和“休息与消化”。

sentences.text: Now, classically, you might have heard of these as referred to fight orflight and rest and digest.
sentences.zh: 因此，交感神经系统是在您的身体需要在极端压力下激活自身时启动的。

sentences.text: So the sympathetic nervous system is what kicks in when your body needs to activate itself in the presence of extreme stress.
sentences.zh: 您可以想到的例子是，如果您需要决定与熊搏斗或从熊身边逃跑时，您会看到的一系列表现和症状。

sentences.text: And the the example you can think about is this is the constellation of findings and symptoms that you'll see if you need to decide to fight a bear or to run away from the bear.
sentences.zh: 而副交感神经系统则完全相反。

sentences.text: And then the parasympathetic nervous system is the complete opposite.
sentences.zh: 这是当您不需要激活大群肌肉和激素，而是处于休息或消化状态时被激活的周围神经系统。

sentences.text: And this is the peripheral nervous system that gets activated when you don't need to activate large groups of muscles and hormones and instead you're either resting or digesting.
sentences.zh: 所以典型的例子是，您吃了一顿大餐，然后当您的身体在腹腔内处理那顿饭时，您会看到一系列症状和表现。

sentences.text: So the classic example is you have a huge meal and then these are the constellations of symptoms and findings that you'll see as your body is just processing that meal in the visca.
sentences.zh: 就受体而言，您应该这样理解：交感神经系统通过α和β受体起作用，而副交感神经系统通过毒蕈碱和烟碱受体起作用。

sentences.text: So the way that you should think about this in terms of receptors is that the sympathetic nervous system works through alpha and beta receptors whereas the parasympathetic nervous system works through muscerinic and nicotinic receptors.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我将这两个神经系统简化为仅两种受体，这有些简化。

sentences.text: Now I'm taking some liberties here when I simplify these two nervous systems down to just two receptors.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，这不是一个详尽的列表，但这是您可以在脑海中形成概念的方式。

sentences.text: Again this is not going to be an allincclusive list but this is how you can think about it to form a conceptualization in your brain.
sentences.zh: 在继续之前，我必须指出一件非常重要的事情：这两个神经系统，或者我应该说自主神经系统的这两个子组成部分，它们相互拮抗。

sentences.text: Now, one thing that's really important that I must point out before we go any further is that these two nervous systems or I should say these two subcomponents of the autonomic nervous system, they work opposite one another.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果副交感神经系统被激活，它将抑制交感神经系统。

sentences.text: So, if the parasympathetic nervous system is activated, it's going to inhibit the sympathetic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 同样地，如果交感神经系统被激活，它将抑制副交感神经系统。

sentences.text: And just just likewise, if the sympathetic nervous system is activated, it's going to inhibit the parasympathetic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 这有点道理，对吧？

sentences.text: And this just kind of makes sense, right?
sentences.zh: 这听起来挺有道理的，对吧？

sentences.text: If you are walking through the woods and all of a sudden a bear comes charging at you, if your body is going to activate the sympathetic nervous system so that you can either fight the bear or run away
sentences.zh: 如果你正在森林里散步，突然一头熊向你冲来，你的身体会激活交感神经系统，这样你就可以要么与熊搏斗，要么逃跑。

sentences.text: from the bear, you don't want your body to be doing things that it would need to do if you were digesting a meal because that would be a waste of resources, a waste of blood, etc. So, just remember
sentences.zh: 远离熊，你不希望身体去做消化食物时需要做的事情，因为那会浪费资源和血液等。所以请记住，

sentences.text: that when one of these systems is activated, the other one is turned off.
sentences.zh: 当其中一个系统被激活时，另一个系统就会被关闭。

sentences.text: And that's going to be useful as you'll see later in this video to try to figure out what the effects of different drugs are based on the mechanism.
sentences.zh: 正如你稍后在本视频中看到的，这将有助于根据机制推断不同药物的效果。

sentences.text: Now, before we go any further, what we probably should do is just paint a general overview of the parasympathetic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 在我们继续之前，可能应该先概述一下副交感神经系统。

sentences.text: The reason I think this is going to be useful is because the bulk of today's video, in fact, all of the pharmarmacology in today's video will be on the parasympathetic side.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有用，因为今天视频的大部分内容，实际上所有药理学内容都将集中在副交感神经方面。

sentences.text: If you're interested in learning about sympathetic pharmarmacology, see my other video about the different types of graphs, etc. I have a video on that.
sentences.zh: 如果你有兴趣学习交感神经药理学，请看我关于不同类型图表等的另一个视频。我有一个关于那个的视频。

sentences.text: It's not as detailed as this one, but I want the focus of this video to be on parasympathetic agents because those are by and large the highest yield that come up on USMLE and complex.
sentences.zh: 它没有这个详细，但我希望这个视频的重点是副交感神经药物，因为这些大体上是USMLE和综合考试中最高频的考点。

sentences.text: So, let's talk briefly about the parasympathetic nervous system.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们简要讨论一下副交感神经系统。

sentences.text: The parasympathetic nervous system functions to control involuntary visceral body organs and it's said to have craniosacral outflow.
sentences.zh: 副交感神经系统功能是控制不自主的内脏器官，据说它有颅骶流出。

sentences.text: Now that's really just a buzzword which means that the parasympa the parasympathetic nervous system originates at the cranial nerves and has functioning down to the sacral nerves.
sentences.zh: 这其实只是一个术语，意思是副交感神经系统起源于脑神经，并向下延伸至骶神经。

sentences.text: Now this is in contrast to the sympathetic nervous system which is said to have thoracco lumbar outflow.
sentences.zh: 这与交感神经系统形成对比，后者据说有胸腰流出。

sentences.text: So, it's really just where those nerve fibers are coming from.
sentences.zh: 所以，这实际上只是神经纤维的来源不同。

sentences.text: What you should really pay attention to, and hence why I put it in red here, is that there are four cranial nerves that have parasympathetic activity.
sentences.zh: 你应该真正注意的是，我在这里用红色标出的，有四个脑神经具有副交感神经活动。

sentences.text: And within those cranial nerve tracks, there are bilateral nuclei that have very specific parasympathetic function.
sentences.zh: 在这些脑神经通路中，有双侧核团具有非常特定的副交感神经功能。

sentences.text: And I've seen this come up.
sentences.zh: 我见过这个考点。

sentences.text: This is incredibly high yield, especially if you're in your first two years of medical school.
sentences.zh: 这是非常高产的考点，尤其是如果你在医学院的前两年。

sentences.text: When you're learning about cranial nerves, when you're learning about the autonomic nervous system, this will probably be on your exam.
sentences.zh: 当你学习脑神经、自主神经系统时，这很可能会出现在你的考试中。

sentences.text: So you need to know the cranial nerve and the corresponding parasympathetic nuclei and what it does.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要知道脑神经及其对应的副交感神经核团及其功能。

sentences.text: So for example, cranial nerve 3 is paired with the edinger westfall nucleus which controls meiosis and accommodation.
sentences.zh: 例如，第三脑神经与埃丁格-韦斯特法尔核配对，控制瞳孔缩小和调节。

sentences.text: Cranial nerve 7 is paired with the superior salivary nucleus which controls salivation specifically in the lacrimal gland.
sentences.zh: 第7对脑神经与上涎核配对，上涎核控制泪腺的唾液分泌。

sentences.text: Cranial nerve 9 is paired with the inferior salivary nucleus which controls salivation in the parotted gland.
sentences.zh: 第9对脑神经与下涎核配对，下涎核控制腮腺的唾液分泌。

sentences.text: And cranial nerve 10 is the dorsal veagal nucleus which controls secretions in the GI tract and lungs.
sentences.zh: 第10对脑神经是背侧迷走神经核，控制胃肠道和肺部的分泌。

sentences.text: This is really high yield because other cranial nerves do not have parasympathetic function and they're also not you know they're not associated with these nuclei in their tracks.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，因为其他脑神经没有副交感功能，也不与这些核团及其通路相关联。

sentences.text: So you need to know again just to summarize here you need to know the cranial nerve the nucleus that it's paired with and what the function of that nucleus/cranial nerve tract does which is shown in blue on this
sentences.zh: 所以你需要再次记住，总结一下：你需要知道脑神经、与之配对的核团，以及该核团/脑神经通路的功能，在幻灯片上用蓝色标出。

sentences.text: slide.
sentences.zh: 幻灯片。

sentences.text: The major neurotransmitter of the parasympathetic nervous system is acetylcholine.
sentences.zh: 副交感神经系统的主要神经递质是乙酰胆碱。

sentences.text: And that's really really important to understand if you're going to keep all of the pharmarmacology straight here.
sentences.zh: 理解这一点非常重要，如果你想把所有药理学知识理清的话。

sentences.text: And we'll we'll touch more on that in just a bit.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会进一步讨论。

sentences.text: But what we need to do now is talk about all the different types of parasympathetic receptors.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们需要做的是讨论所有不同类型的副交感受体。

sentences.text: Now the parasympathetic nervous system, if you go back to the slide a couple slides ago, I told you that it it functions through muscerinic receptors and nicotinic receptors.
sentences.zh: 副交感神经系统，如果你回到前几张幻灯片，我告诉过你它通过毒蕈碱受体和烟碱受体发挥作用。

sentences.text: And the way that you'll see this written out in review textbooks or question banks or even on your exam is with the capital letter M or the capital letter N.
sentences.zh: 在复习教材、题库甚至考试中，你会看到它们用大写字母M或大写字母N表示。

sentences.text: For the purposes of today's video, we're only going to talk about muscerinic receptors because the nicotinic receptors are are really not that high yield.
sentences.zh: 就今天的视频而言，我们只讨论毒蕈碱受体，因为烟碱受体实际上不那么重要。

sentences.text: They're just not.
sentences.zh: 它们确实不重要。

sentences.text: The muscerinic receptors, they very much are.
sentences.zh: 毒蕈碱受体则非常重要。

sentences.text: So, we're going to talk about all these different subtypes of muscerinic receptors, which I will denote with the capital letter M.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们将讨论所有不同亚型的毒蕈碱受体，我会用大写字母M表示。

sentences.text: And these are the receptors that acetylcholine is binding to or that the drug is binding to and either being an agonist or an antagonist.
sentences.zh: 这些是乙酰胆碱结合或药物结合的受体，药物可以是激动剂或拮抗剂。

sentences.text: So again, before we get to the pharmacology, you need to understand receptors.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，在进入药理学之前，你需要理解受体。

sentences.text: So let's just kind of make a chart here.
sentences.zh: 让我们在这里画个图表。

sentences.text: I don't love charts, but you'll see some charts in today's video because it'll help your brain keep all of this information neat and tidy.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢图表，但今天的视频中你会看到一些图表，因为它们能帮助你保持所有信息整洁有序。

sentences.text: So the first receptors that we should talk about are M1, M4 and M5 muscerinic receptors.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要讨论的第一个受体是M1、M4和M5毒蕈碱受体。

sentences.text: These are all located in the CNS, the central nervous system.
sentences.zh: 这些受体都位于中枢神经系统（CNS）。

sentences.text: And really they control cognition.
sentences.zh: 实际上它们控制认知功能。

sentences.text: So when you give somebody a drug that is an agonist at any one of these three receptors, it has proco- cognitive effects.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是这三个受体中任何一个的激动剂时，它会产生促认知效应。

sentences.text: So it helps them learn, it helps them pay attention, it helps them speak, it helps them do spatial tasks, verbal tasks, etc. And then consequently, if you give somebody a drug which is an antagonist at M1, M4 or
sentences.zh: 也就是说，它有助于学习、注意力、说话、空间任务、语言任务等。因此，如果你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是M1、M4或M5的拮抗剂，

sentences.text: M5, this has the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 则会产生相反的效果。

sentences.text: So, it's anti-cognitive, which means if you give somebody an anti-muscarinic drug, meaning you're blocking a muscerinic receptor, specifically M1, M4, or M5, it makes it harder for them to learn and do cognitive tasks.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是抗认知的，意味着如果你给某人服用抗毒蕈碱药物，即阻断毒蕈碱受体，特别是M1、M4或M5，会使他们更难学习和完成认知任务。

sentences.text: The next receptor that we need to talk about is the M2 receptor.
sentences.zh: 下一个需要讨论的受体是M2受体。

sentences.text: And this is located in the heart.
sentences.zh: 它位于心脏。

sentences.text: If you give somebody a drug which is an agonist at the M2 receptor, it causes breda cardia.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是M2受体的激动剂，会导致心动过缓。

sentences.text: And if you give somebody a drug which is an antagonist at the M2 receptor, it causes well the opposite tacocardia.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是M2受体的拮抗剂，则会导致相反的心动过速。

sentences.text: And it also causes increased AV nodal conduction.
sentences.zh: 它还会增加房室结传导。

sentences.text: The next receptor we need to talk about is the M3 receptor.
sentences.zh: 下一个需要讨论的受体是M3受体。

sentences.text: And there's actually five different locations where this M3 receptor is found.
sentences.zh: 实际上，M3受体存在于五个不同的位置。

sentences.text: As you can see in that in the cells that I bolded there for you.
sentences.zh: 正如你在我为你加粗的细胞中看到的那样。

sentences.text: So every other uh site that I'm going to talk about now, these are all M3 receptors.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在要讨论的其他所有位点都是M3受体。

sentences.text: So they'll all fall in that line and below.
sentences.zh: 它们都属于那一行及以下。

sentences.text: The first M3 receptor that we're going to talk about is found in the urinary tract.
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论的第一个M3受体位于泌尿道。

sentences.text: And if you give somebody a drug which is an agonist at the M3 receptor, it will cause bladder contraction which will cause urination because the bladder has to squeeze and contract and push that urine out.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是M3受体的激动剂，会导致膀胱收缩，从而引起排尿，因为膀胱必须挤压收缩并排出尿液。

sentences.text: And then consequently, if you give somebody a drug which is an antagonist at the M3 receptor, it will cause bladder relaxation, which will be the opposite of urination.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你给某人服用一种药物，该药物是M3受体的拮抗剂，会导致膀胱松弛，这与排尿相反。

sentences.text: So, it'll cause urinary retention.
sentences.zh: 所以，它会导致尿潴留。

sentences.text: Now, this should make a little bit of sense to you because if you've studied any of your versus antiolinergic medications, you might be familiar with the fact that if you give somebody an antiolinergic drug, it causes urinary retention.
sentences.zh: 现在，这对你来说应该有点道理，因为如果你学过任何抗胆碱能药物，你可能熟悉这样一个事实：如果你给某人服用抗胆碱能药物，它会导致尿潴留。

sentences.text: And the reason is on a microscopic level because you're antagonizing M3 receptors found in the urinary tract.
sentences.zh: 原因是在微观层面上，因为你拮抗了泌尿道的M3受体。

sentences.text: The next location that we'll talk about for M3 receptors is the GI tract.
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论的M3受体的下一个位置是胃肠道。

sentences.text: When you give somebody a drug which acts as an agonist at the M3 receptor in the GI tract, it causes paristalsis.
sentences.zh: 当你给某人服用一种在胃肠道中作为M3受体激动剂的药物时，它会引起蠕动。

sentences.text: So this causes bowel movements, diarrhea if you give too much.
sentences.zh: 所以这会导致排便，如果用药过量会导致腹泻。

sentences.text: But if you give a drug that's an antagonist at the M3 receptor in the GI tract and causes the opposite effect, it decreases paristtoalsis.
sentences.zh: 但如果你给一种在胃肠道中作为M3受体拮抗剂的药物，它会产生相反的效果，即减少蠕动。

sentences.text: So giving somebody too much of an anti-muscarinic agent that's antagonizing the M3 receptor in the GI tract causes things like constipation.
sentences.zh: 所以给某人服用过多的抗毒蕈碱药物，拮抗胃肠道的M3受体，会导致便秘等问题。

sentences.text: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.text: So just try to keep all of this information straight in your head.
sentences.zh: 所以尽量把这些信息都记在脑子里。

sentences.text: And I hope you're building a framework to understand versus antiolineric as we go.
sentences.zh: 我希望你在学习过程中正在构建一个理解抗胆碱能药物的框架。

sentences.text: The next location of M3 receptors are the exocrine glands.
sentences.zh: M3受体的下一个位置是外分泌腺。

sentences.text: When you give somebody a drug which acts as an agonist at the M3 receptors in the exocrine glands, it causes an increased level of secretions coming from that gland.
sentences.zh: 当你给某人服用一种作为外分泌腺中M3受体激动剂的药物时，会导致该腺体分泌增加。

sentences.text: And then if you give somebody a drug which is an antagonist at the M3 receptors in the exocrine glands, it causes the opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果你给某人服用一种作为外分泌腺中M3受体拮抗剂的药物，会产生相反的效果。

sentences.text: It decreases secretions.
sentences.zh: 它会减少分泌。

sentences.text: So this is why when you give somebody an antiolineric also known as antimuscerinic drug that blocks the M3 receptor in the exocrine gland you cause the side effect of dry mouth.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当你给某人服用一种抗胆碱能药物（也称为抗毒蕈碱药物）阻断外分泌腺中的M3受体时，会引起口干副作用。

sentences.text: The next location that we'll talk about for the M3 receptors is in the eye.
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论的M3受体的下一个位置是眼睛。

sentences.text: If you give somebody a drug which is an agonist at the M3 receptor in the eye, it causes meiosis.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人服用一种作为眼睛中M3受体激动剂的药物，会引起瞳孔缩小。

sentences.text: If you give somebody a drug that's an antagonist at the M3 receptor in the eye, it causes the opposite.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人服用一种作为眼睛中M3受体拮抗剂的药物，会产生相反的效果。

sentences.text: It causes madriasis.
sentences.zh: 它会引起瞳孔散大。

sentences.text: And these are th these receptors um these M3 receptors in the eye.
sentences.zh: 这些是眼睛中的M3受体。

sentences.text: This is the reason that certain muscerinic or antimuscerinic drugs are used in glaucoma.
sentences.zh: 这就是某些毒蕈碱或抗毒蕈碱药物用于治疗青光眼的原因。

sentences.text: The final location of M3 receptors that we'll talk about is in the airway.
sentences.zh: 我们要讨论的M3受体的最后一个位置是在气道中。

sentences.text: If you give somebody a drug which is an agonist at the M3 receptor in the airway, it causes bronco constriction.
sentences.zh: 如果你给某人一种药物，它是气道中M3受体的激动剂，会导致支气管收缩。

sentences.text: And then the opposite, if you give somebody a drug which is an antagonist at the M3 receptor in the airway, it causes bronco dilation.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果你给某人一种药物，它是气道中M3受体的拮抗剂，会导致支气管扩张。

sentences.text: Now, let's pause for a second because I just threw a ton of information at you and I don't want to overwhelm you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们暂停一下，因为我刚刚向你抛出了大量信息，我不想让你不知所措。
